summary: Andrew (31) took a 40-foot leader fall on Rosy Toit, Redgarden Wall, when protection pulled; shattered his right ankle with an open fibula fracture; yelled for climbers below to call 911.
location: Rosy Toit, Redgarden Wall, Eldorado Canyon
notes: ANAC 2023 edition (Pub 2023); incident date Apr 2 per article.
